steps.en: Add the package and put a model API key in .env
steps.zh: 装上包，把模型 API 密钥写进 .env

steps.en: Create an Agent with a one-sentence task and the model you chose, then run it
steps.zh: 用一句话任务和选好的模型创建 Agent，然后运行

steps.en: Opens a browser and turns the page into an indexed list of clickable elements
steps.zh: 打开浏览器，把页面变成带编号的可交互元素列表

steps.en: Asks the model for the next actions and executes them, step after step, until done
steps.zh: 每一步问模型要下一组动作并执行，直到完成

steps.en: Read the final answer from the run history
steps.zh: 从运行历史里取出最终结果

value.en: A website task described in one sentence gets done without a hand-written selector per click, and survives layout changes that break scripts
value.zh: 一句话描述的网站任务就能完成，不用为每次点击手写选择器，页面改版也不会像脚本那样直接挂掉
